extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: open-wheel formula race car, approx. 5.2 x 2.0 x 1.0 m (L x W x H), wheel diameter 0.68 m (front) / 0.72 m (rear)
extras.notes: front faces -Y; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll; the front wheels can also steer around local Z); the steering wheel (race-car_steering_wheel) is a separate object with origin at its hub; open cockpit with seat, halo safety bar; no sponsors, no start number, no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
